CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dm_plan(actor uuid, account_role text DEFAULT 'student'::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when account_role='student' and exists(
      select 1 from public.teacher_portal_guests g
      join public.teacher_portal_access a on a.id=g.access_id and a.state='approved'
      join public.teachers t on t.id=a.teacher_id and t.active and t.frozen_at is null
      where g.student_id=actor and g.alias='Premium Oyun' and g.preview
        and t.is_admin and t.username='teacher'
    ) then 'premium_pro'
    when account_role='student' and exists(
      select 1 from public.teacher_portal_guests g
      join public.teacher_portal_access a on a.id=g.access_id and a.state='approved'
      join public.teachers t on t.id=a.teacher_id and t.active and t.frozen_at is null
      where g.student_id=actor and g.alias='Premium Oyun' and g.preview
    ) then (
      select public.dm_plan(a.teacher_id,'teacher')
      from public.teacher_portal_guests g
      join public.teacher_portal_access a on a.id=g.access_id
      where g.student_id=actor and g.alias='Premium Oyun' and g.preview
      limit 1
    )
    when exists(select 1 from public.dm_entitlements e
      where e.account_id=actor and e.account_role=dm_plan.account_role and e.state='active'
        and (e.valid_until is null or e.valid_until>now())
        and e.product_key = any(case when dm_plan.account_role='teacher'
          then array['teacher_premium_pro']
          else array['diji_premium_pro','premium','premium_plus','premium_max',
            'diji_premium','diji_premium_plus','diji_premium_max'] end))
      then 'premium_pro'
    when exists(select 1 from public.dm_entitlements e
      where e.account_id=actor and e.account_role=dm_plan.account_role and e.state='active'
        and (e.valid_until is null or e.valid_until>now())
        and e.product_key=case when dm_plan.account_role='teacher' then 'teacher_pro' else 'diji_pro' end)
      then 'pro'
    else 'free'
  end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dm_game_trial_active(joined date, today date)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select today < greatest(joined,date '2026-11-14')+3
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dm_premium_level_reward(p_level integer, p_total integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(xp integer, gold integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with rate as (
    select case when p_total<=1 then 1::numeric else
      least(1, greatest(0, (p_level-1)::numeric / greatest(1, (p_total::bigint*3)/4)))
    end as progress
  )
  select 20 + round(165*progress)::integer, 5 + round(40*progress)::integer from rate;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dm_pwm_energy(st students)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when st.energy>=st.energy_max then st.energy
    else least(st.energy_max, st.energy+greatest(0,floor(extract(epoch from now()-coalesce(st.energy_updated_at,now()))/900))::int) end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dm_pwm_is_premium(actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select public.dm_plan(actor,'student')='premium_pro'
    or (public.dm_plan(actor,'student')='pro' and exists(
      select 1 from public.teacher_portal_guests g
      where g.student_id=actor and g.alias='Premium Oyun' and g.preview
    ))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dm_pwm_star(level_no integer, star integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  -- premium-word-match-core.js starScore() ile birebir aynı olmalı.
  select floor(((case when least(100,greatest(1,level_no))<=4 then 8000 when least(100,greatest(1,level_no))<=49 then 6500 else 5500 end)
    + least(100,greatest(1,level_no))*20) * (array[0.5,1.0,1.3])[greatest(1,least(3,star))])::int
$function$
